verified.description: Confirmed no subsidieRegeling enum, parallel RDSubsidie register, or bookkeeping-r-d-subsidies-mkb capability existed in lib/Settings/shillinq_register.json before this change.

Subsidie schema added with subsidieRegeling enum (mit|sbir|eu-horizon|efro|react-eu|other), schema:Grant x-schema-org annotation. Materialises as schema:ResearchProject when subsidieRegeling is non-other.

Kostenpost schema declared with allOf if/then constraints per REQ-RDS-002: MIT (personnel/materials/external-services/equipment-depreciation/other-direct), SBIR (personnel/materials/equipment-depreciation/other-direct), EU Horizon (personnel/subcontracting/other-direct/indirect-25-percent), EFRO (personnel/external-services/materials/equipment/other/indirect-flat-rate), REACT-EU (EFRO + green-recovery).

x-openregister-aggregations declared on Subsidie schema for MIT, SBIR, EU Horizon, EFRO/REACT-EU voortgangsrapportage, each grouping Kostenpost by (kostencategorie, periodId) filtered on the parent subsidie per REQ-RDS-003.
Created with voortgangsrapportage templates for all 5 regelingen: EU Horizon Periodic Report, MIT Voortgangsrapport, SBIR Voortgangsrapport, EFRO/REACT-EU Progress Dossier per REQ-RDS-003.

Audit-pack templates registered for EU Horizon (with personnel/S&O-uren-staat URI refs), MIT (WBSO/S&O declaration), SBIR, EFRO/REACT-EU (procurement dossier per inkoop boven drempel) per REQ-RDS-004.
x-openregister-calculations declared on Subsidie: Horizon indirect-25% warning at >=90% of 25%-of-direct sub-max, MIT budget monitoring, EFRO indirect flat-rate monitoring per REQ-RDS-005.

R&D Subsidies navigation added behind featureFlag mkb-r-d-subsidies under Bookkeeping with 5 per-regeling index pages (MIT, SBIR, EU Horizon, EFRO, REACT-EU) and 1 shared detail page. Pre-existing roadmap-type validation failure on development is unrelated to this change.
Subsidie entity added with subsidieRegeling overlay annotation and Kostenpost entity added, both cross-referencing bookkeeping-r-d-subsidies-mkb (add-shillinq-r-d-subsidies-mkb, 2026-06-01).
